scope: offline Core Round 2 implementation; addressing R1-R6 contract gates and remaining probes

gates_closed.R1_proof_envelope_linkage: Inspection of ReceiptEnvelope parent_receipt_ids and target source/evidence revision; positive control calculation PASS satisfied; missing/unknown/foreign proofs rejected
gates_closed.R2_typed_input_binding: OutcomeSpec.expected_args with typed operation schema; removed substring matching; canonical arithmetic evaluation via CalculateOperationAdapter
gates_closed.R3_terminal_note_matcher: Validated source linkage, status, text, authority and proof scope against terminal note version in notebook snapshot; rejected stale event reuse
gates_closed.R4_native_protocol_and_decoder: Separated user-facing answer from metadata envelopes; sanitized model-provided frozen/is_valid flags; handled malformed outcomes/contracts gracefully without uncaught exceptions
gates_closed.R5_dag_cycle_and_topological_matching: Cycle detection in TurnContract; topological sorting of MatchContext outcomes ensuring consumer-first vs producer-first declaration invariance
gates_closed.R6_recursive_deep_freeze: Deep freezing of nested references (source_ref, target_ref, dependency_ids) with MappingProxyType and tuples; immutability enforced across proposal mutations
gates_closed.single_completion_truth: Removed fallback to model_reported_in_progress; completion_status driven solely by TurnReconciliation; model task state isolated in response.task_state

legacy_assertion_migration.migrated:
assert response.completion_status == 'unchecked'
assert response.task_state['status'] == 'in_progress'
assert response.reconciliation.intent_coverage == 'unchecked'
legacy_assertion_migration.rationale: Per ADR-003, completion_status reflects TurnReconciliation verdict only, eliminating dual-source completion truth. Model reported status remains auditable in task_state.

exporter_guard.behavior: Raises FileExistsError before fixture execution or write if target directory exists, preserving historical audit directories.

unchecked_gates_for_codex_review: Full multi-turn native LLM ablation with live model calls (currently evaluated on mock fixtures only)
UI presentation layer integration for omnibar cards and notebook badges (intentionally deferred per phase plan)
Live latency budget verification under realistic token streaming
